mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_category (name, sort, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, sort, status, create_time, update_time FROM article_category WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, sort, status, create_time, update_time FROM article_category WHERE name = #{name}
